name: Craig Hicks
bio:
Craig Hicks is a highly skilled tattoo artist based in Manchester, UK, specializing in black & gray and realism that bring intricate designs to life with precision and artistry. Apart from his tattooing prowess, Craig's professionalism is evident from the first point of contact through email to the final touches of your tattoo, ensuring a seamless and satisfying artistic experience. His dedication to his craft is paralleled by his involvement in other creative endeavors as a painter, writer, and photographer, showcasing his diverse artistic talents.
